# Fixture: OpenCode standalone child Sessions

This sanitized fixture is generated by `collaboration_test.go` in a temporary
SQLite database. It models the current OpenCode collaboration shape without
copying a real user database:

- `session.parent_id` links the root Session to a child and a nested child.
- The parent `task` parts carry the source-recorded child `sessionId`, task
  title, `background` mode, call ID, and completed state.
- Each child has its own user/assistant messages, so the adapter can expose a
  native backing Session and exact child content.
- The child Session IDs are the native resume IDs and collaboration identities.

The fixture intentionally uses only synthetic IDs, timestamps, paths, model
names, and short transcript text. The test also covers an older schema without
`parent_id`, where the adapter returns a valid root-only graph with estimated
completeness.
